stories.title: Am letzten Tag: Mitarbeiter auf Oktoberfest schwer verletzt

en.title: On the last day: Oktoberfest employee seriously injured
en.summary: A 47-year-old man was seriously injured at a carousel ride and was resuscitated by emergency services before being transported to a hospital. The cause of the accident remains unclear.

stories.title: Holocaustüberlebende: Zeitzeugin Irene Butter ist gestorben

en.title: Holocaust survivor: Witness Irene Butter has died
en.summary: Irene Butter, who survived the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp and testified for decades about Nazi crimes, died at age 95.

stories.title: Oktoberfest: Betriebsunfall auf der Oidn Wiesn: Mitarbeiter von Schiffsschaukel schwer verletzt

en.title: Oktoberfest: Operational accident at the Oidn Wiesn: Carousel employee seriously injured
en.summary: A 47-year-old man suffered serious injuries at the amusement ride, was resuscitated at the scene, and was taken to a clinic for treatment.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Merz besucht Kiew - Russland greift Brücke an

en.title: War against Ukraine: Merz visits Kyiv - Russia strikes bridge
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz visited Kyiv where a Russian attack on a bridge occurred. Merz pledged support to Ukraine and met with President Zelenskyy.

stories.title: Eklat nach Frage: Pressekonferenz vor Irland-Spiel gegen Israel wird abgebrochen

en.title: Incident after question: Press conference before Ireland-Israel match is terminated
en.summary: A media briefing before the Nations League match between Ireland and Israel escalated following a journalist's question, intensifying tensions surrounding the fixture.

stories.title: Deutsche Bahn will Familienticket dauerhaft anbieten

en.title: German Railways wants to offer family ticket permanently
en.summary: Deutsche Bahn intends to provide family tickets as a permanent offering beyond its summer promotion period.

stories.title: Deutsche Bahn bietet Familienticket nach Sommeraktion dauerhaft an

en.title: German Railways offers family ticket permanently after summer promotion
en.summary: Starting November 1st, Deutsche Bahn will permanently offer family tickets. The railway's chief executive indicated no quick improvements in train punctuality are expected.

stories.title: Ukraine-Besuch: Merz in Kiew: „Auf unsere Hilfe könnt ihr weiter zählen“

en.title: Ukraine Visit: Merz in Kyiv: "You can continue to rely on our help"
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz visited Kyiv for the second time during his tenure as part of the federal government's diplomatic efforts to support Ukraine.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Kanzler Merz besucht Kiew

en.title: War against Ukraine: Chancellor Merz visits Kyiv
en.summary: Chancellor Merz arrived in Kyiv for a solidarity visit to discuss further military support for Ukraine, following prior Russian warnings against such travel.

stories.title: Russland-Ukraine-Krieg: Friedrich Merz überraschend in Kyjiw eingetroffen

en.title: Russia-Ukraine War: Friedrich Merz arrives unexpectedly in Kyiv
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz made a solidarity visit to Ukraine and pledged additional aid for its defense efforts amid drone alarms in the capital.

stories.title: Ab November: Deutsche Bahn führt Familienticket dauerhaft ein

en.title: From November: German Railway introduces family ticket permanently
en.summary: German Railway will offer a family ticket as a permanent fare option starting in November at 99.99 euros for round-trip travel. The railway reported the fixed price was successful during a summer trial.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Kanzler Merz in Kiew an Putin: „Hören Sie diesen sinnlosen Krieg auf“

en.title: Ukraine War: Chancellor Merz tells Putin in Kyiv: "Stop this senseless war"
en.summary: Chancellor Merz made an unexpected visit to Ukraine despite security concerns, after Russia issued warnings and conducted multiple attacks on the capital.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: Amazon investiert mehr als der deutsche Staat – wer kann diese Macht begrenzen?

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: Amazon invests more than the German state – who can limit this power?
en.summary: Major US technology companies now have financial resources exceeding those of entire nations, according to a Handelsblatt analysis that examines this significant shift in power and raises questions about oversight.

stories.title: Öl: Opec plus will Förderziele für November offenbar beibehalten

en.title: Oil: Opec plus apparently plans to maintain production targets for November
en.summary: Gulf oil-producing nations have recently operated below their production targets due to regional conflict, though Opec plus has lost market influence.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Huthis haben nach eigenen Angaben Aramco-Anlage in Riad angegriffen

en.title: +++ Iran-War +++: Houthis claim attack on Aramco facility in Riyadh
en.summary: A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by projectiles, Iran's currency reached historic lows, and a Flydubai copilot was reportedly previously flagged as a security risk.

stories.title: Parlamentswahl: Ergebnis verdreifacht: Pro-europäische Regierungspartei in Lettland siegt überraschend klar

en.title: Parliamentary election: Result tripled: Pro-European ruling party in Latvia wins by surprising margin
en.summary: Latvia's ruling party achieved a decisive electoral victory supporting EU and Ukraine policies, positioning Prime Minister Kulbergs to form the next government.
